environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'media-processing' with service type LoadBalancer exposing port 8080 directly. Pod has hostNetwork: false but the LoadBalancer has no ingress restrictions. No NetworkPolicy applied. Environment variables CF_KEY_PAIR_ID and CF_PRIVATE_KEY injected via Kubernetes Secret mounted as env vars. The /debug/cache endpoint is accessible from any source that can reach the LoadBalancer's external IP.
